parameters.completionMessage: Write at least one full sentence about what you want to build and who it is for, then try again.

parameters.content:
## Design Team
Five fictional AI specialists work on one brief, each as its own n8n Agent with its own memory.

**To use it:** open /form/design-team, describe what you want, press Start and wait on the page.

The run never stops for a question. If one specialist fails, the others continue and the report says so.

## Separate memory
Each agent has its own n8n Agent memory. Long-term notes are filtered by agent name in code, so no agent sees another one's notes.

## The studio
Dr. Vance frames the brief, Prof. Okafor researches, Mira Castellane prioritises, Kenji Aldaine designs. Pauses keep the run inside the Groq free tier.

## Developer on standby
Soren Vale is woken only when Dr. Vance reads the brief as a build. Otherwise this step is skipped.

## Review and report
Dr. Vance reviews the work. Each agent saves one lesson to its own notes. The report opens on the form page.
